_note: Package names marked verified:false were seeded from memory and should be confirmed against a real device with `swagperf apps discover`. Play Store listings and package names drift.

apps.name: Swag Pay
apps.notes: Emits step: markers, so extract.py reads them directly. Budgets come from the shell architecture.

apps.name: Swag Pay
apps.notes: The iOS build. Its bundle id is still the prototype's placeholder: change it here and in iosApp.xcodeproj together. No budgets yet; iOS budgets are set from physical-device runs.

apps.name: PhonePe
apps.notes: Market leader by UPI volume. React Native in parts, useful comparison for the Hermes surface.

apps.name: Google Pay (India)
apps.notes: Formerly Tez. Heavily optimised native; a realistic performance ceiling.

apps.name: Paytm
apps.notes: Large superapp. Expect slow cold start and high RAM usage; useful as an upper bound.

apps.name: CRED
apps.notes: Known for heavy animation; a good frame-pacing comparison.

apps.name: WhatsApp
apps.notes: Carries UPI payments in India. Extremely well optimised startup.

apps.name: Chrome
apps.notes: Not a competitor. Present on every device, so it is a good smoke test that capture and derivation work.

apps.name: Clock
apps.notes: Tiny app, near-floor cold start. Useful to sanity-check that measured TTID is not dominated by capture overhead.
